definitions.explanation: The act of not agreeing to or not accepting a proposal, request, or situation. A formal expression of refusal or objection.

examples.japanese: {不承知|ふしょうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The discussion proceeded without my consent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不承知|ふしょうち}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実行|じっこう}できない→実行する：22146_jikkousuru⟧。
examples.english: The president disapproves, so this plan cannot be carried out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不承知|ふしょうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}し{切|き}って→押し切る：06793_oshikiru⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They married despite their parents' disapproval.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word. The opposite is ⟦{承知|しょうち}→承知：02086_shouchi⟧ (consent, understanding). Can be used as a na-adjective: {不承知|ふしょうち}な.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不承知|ふしょうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}し{切|き}る→押し切る：06793_oshikiru⟧ (to override disapproval)
- {不承知|ふしょうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま (without consent)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不同意|ふどうい}: disagreement — more neutral, legal term
- ⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧: opposition — stronger, more active disagreement
- ⟦{承知|しょうち}→承知：02086_shouchi⟧: consent, understanding — the positive counterpart
